name: skia-canvas
role: Canvas 2D API on Skia for Node: PNG frames and outlined SVG from one drawing function, no browser
summary: skia-canvas implements the HTML Canvas 2D API in Node on Skia with prebuilt native binaries. It renders on the CPU to PNG, JPEG, WEBP, raw pixels, SVG and multi-page PDF, loads fonts from local files, and can outline text to paths in SVG. Its strength is running ordinary Canvas 2D scene code headlessly, with no Chromium capture loop.
use_when: Canvas 2D scene code as PNG frames in Node with no browser; over canvas-2d when no capture loop is wanted
The same drawing calls needed as raster frames and as vector SVG or PDF
Over canvaskit-skia when the familiar Canvas API is wanted rather than the lower-level Skia one
avoid_when: Shaped paragraphs, SkSL shaders or path boolean ops: canvaskit-skia
3D or GPU-heavy scenes: three-js or pixijs
DOM or CSS layout: playwright capture
notes: 2026-11-27: set canvas.gpu = false for reproducible CPU pixels; fonts must be registered with FontLibrary.use from files. Byte equality across macOS and Linux is not checked. @napi-rs/canvas is a similar alternative, not assessed.

assessment.rationale: npm skia-canvas 4.0.1 (MIT) published 2026-11-14, repository pushed the same day. Prebuilt native binary installed through pnpm with no system dependency. Adds headless Canvas 2D to PNG, SVG and PDF in Node, which canvas-2d (browser capture) and canvaskit-skia (WASM, lower-level API) do not.

evidence.result: Canvas 2D scene of t=0, 0.5, 1 to 640x360 CPU PNGs and an outlined-text SVG in separate Node 22.19.0 processes: identical SHA-256 for all 3 PNGs and the SVG; pixel probes matched; SVG has 0 text or font references; resvg 0.47.0 raster 640x360 inspected.
evidence.scope: Rects, arc and one registered-font text line, CPU raster, PNG and outlined SVG on macOS arm64; not GPU, PDF, other OS byte equality, system fonts or speed.
